title: Đào tạo nghề và quyền lựa chọn · Advantages / Disadvantages
prompt: In some societies, placing more school leavers in vocational training rather than university is being considered. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

grammar.why: Điều kiện trong câu giới hạn kết quả theo hoàn cảnh được nêu; không được bỏ điều kiện rồi coi hệ quả luôn xảy ra. Không kết luận học nghề tốt hơn đại học cho mọi học sinh. paragraphs: Vocational education offers paid practical learning, but directing teenagers away from university can make an early preference difficult to reverse. The employment and income gains outweigh the disadvantages when vocational qualifications permit later academic entry, since practical training then adds an option instead of permanently removing one.

Vocational routes can make education more relevant to students with practical interests. Workplace placements connect technical instruction with tasks for which employers actually recruit. A trainee electrician can develop supervised competence while earning a modest wage. Paid practice also reduces the income forgone during training, which can matter to students unable to postpone earning for several more years. The case is strongest where placements teach transferable skills and lead to genuine vacancies, rather than simply supplying employers with cheap temporary labour.

Early tracking can close academic opportunities before a young person's interests have matured. A teenager's initial route may determine which subjects and qualifications remain available later. If switching requires repeating years of study or meeting inaccessible entry requirements, an early practical preference can become a lasting restriction rather than a freely revisable choice. Vocational qualifications should offer credible routes into further academic study. Transfer routes should recognise vocational learning and set achievable entry requirements, so a practical choice at sixteen does not become an irreversible academic exclusion. A vocational system should be assessed both by employment outcomes and by whether students retain a realistic route into further academic study.
A stronger vocational sector deserves priority as an additional route to secure work, with success depending on both the skills acquired and the freedom to change direction.

paragraphs.quote: Early tracking can close academic opportunities before a young person's interests have matured. A teenager's initial route may determine which subjects and qualifications remain available later. If switching requires repeating years of study or meeting inaccessible entry requirements, an early practical preference can become a lasting restriction rather than a freely revisable choice. Vocational qualifications should offer credible routes into further academic study. Transfer routes should recognise vocational learning and set achievable entry requirements, so a practical choice at sixteen does not become an irreversible academic exclusion. A vocational system should be assessed both by employment outcomes and by whether students retain a realistic route into further academic study.
paragraphs.why: Phân luồng quá sớm làm lựa chọn hôm nay khóa cơ hội ngày mai. Lộ trình liên thông xử lý tính khó đảo ngược đó; chỉ quảng bá học nghề không khôi phục quyền chuyển hướng học thuật.
